scope: Reuse the pinned lazy MarketSearch per document in one owned Win7 worker
implementation: The private session driver retains an unchanged Source MarketSearch for each live URL/fetchedAt identity. The index is transferred once, text indexing stays lazy, and simultaneous readers share its build. Paging and live manager annotation remain on the Host.

Current cache identities and active readers retain search instances; refresh/removal drops retired instances. The worker is lazy, caller cancellation leaves accepted work and other readers alive, and service lifetime/deadline cancellation owns spawn through reaping.

Unexpected process exit or deadline failure closes the old pool. A later query waits for its cleanup and reconstructs the pool from valid cached documents. Resource bundles were rebuilt from unchanged pinned Source with byte/license provenance.

native.scope: Persistent multilingual/1101-entry concurrent and repeated queries, refresh/removal, caller cancellation, lifetime abort, deadline, abort during delayed spawn, crash recovery and direct parser/cache/listing/Remote consumers; actual x86 persistent queries match x64 outcomes

paired.scope: Unchanged Source MarketSearch with multilingual NFKC/CJK/fuzzy terms, taxonomy, published/custom sort keys, repeated queries and 1001-entry chunking

source.scope: Unmodified market.spec.ts; the earlier attempted nonexistent search.spec.ts collected zero and is not passing evidence

browser.scope: Original optional Discover save/list/search/detail/image/reload/mobile; subsequent crash-recovery addition verified by Native direct consumers, not a new full browser/release receipt

cleanup.removed: Owned native/source short workspaces/home/tmp, copied generated build payloads and candidate52 home; verified generated resource hashes before removing redundant copies
cleanup.retained: Commands/logs/XML, Source results, paired input/observations/hashes, compact build receipt and browser screenshots. Shared Source/toolchain remain for C1-C9.

limitations: This is a private Win7 process adaptation with a 30-second operation deadline; it does not certify the 128 MiB maximum input or arbitrary workload performance.
No new live external index/CDN/Git or actual Win7 OS qualification is claimed.
Production pin/composition promotion and full release acceptance remain pending.
